sources.entry: graphify - Turns code, SQL schemas, docs, papers, images, or videos into a queryable knowledge graph.

summary.one_liner: Graphify turns a project's code, docs, PDFs, images, and videos into a queryable knowledge graph for AI coding assistants, with code parsed locally via tree-sitter.
summary.what_it_does: Running /graphify in an AI coding assistant builds a knowledge graph of a folder, written to graphify-out/ as graph.html, GRAPH_REPORT.md, and graph.json. Code is parsed locally with tree-sitter AST without an LLM, and cross-file calls, imports, inheritance, and mixins are resolved across about 40 languages. Docs, PDFs, images, and video/audio go through a semantic pass that uses the assistant's model or a configured API key. Every edge is tagged EXTRACTED (explicit in source) or INFERRED (resolved by graphify). The CLI offers query, path, and explain commands against graph.json, and the report lists god nodes, communities, and surprising connections. The README also describes a hook for auto-rebuilding on commit, an MCP stdio server, and watch mode.
use_cases: query a codebase without grepping files
map architecture and subsystems of a repo
trace how two classes or functions connect
give an AI coding assistant persistent project context
build a knowledge graph from docs and PDFs alongside code
review pull requests with graph context
how_to_run: graphify query "what connects auth to the database?"
stack: Leiden community detection (optional extra) with networkx Louvain fallback
notable: Code graph built fully offline with tree-sitter AST, no LLM or API key needed for code-only corpora
Every edge labeled EXTRACTED or INFERRED so direct reads are distinguishable from inferred links
Query, path, and explain commands return scoped subgraphs instead of full file reads
Installs skills for 20+ AI assistants through a single graphify install step
Optional extras for PDF, Office, video transcription, Neo4j, and FalkorDB pushes
caveats: Docs, PDFs, images, and video need an assistant model or a configured API key/backend for the semantic pass
Without the leiden extra, clustering falls back to networkx Louvain, and switching later reshuffles communities
Graphify Cloud is a separate paid-after-trial hosted offering (14-day free trial) that the README promotes; features described there are not part of this repo's local tool
Some platforms lack parallel extraction or hook support (for example Aider and OpenClaw sequential only; Trae has no PreToolUse hook)
